• You will have Senior Real Estate experience, gained at a City firm, or at an overseas common law practice with a highly regarded profile and a good grounding in real estate as an asset class.
• Ideally you will have corporate real estate experience, but this is not essential - we are primarily interested in a genuine commitment to being a real estate lawyer first and foremost and interest in working across different industry sectors and asset classes, however, should be open to developing your skills over time to include corporate real estate.
• You will naturally be able to demonstrate excellent document drafting skills.  You should also demonstrate strong communication and analytical skills, along with a high level of commercial awareness and will have had strong exposure of collaborating with multi-disciplinary teams.
• It is crucial that you can demonstrate an appetite for developing client relationships and thought leadership.
• A strong academic history is essential.

Additional Information
How we will support you
From your first day with us, you will have varied opportunities to continuously grow and development your skills and knowledge. From formal training, informal coaching and mentoring through to skills-based and technical training and on the job learning.

Requirements

This role suits engineers with a strong grounding in software engineering practice: test-driven development, pair programming, and real ownership of systems from design through to production support, with real depth in Java or a comparable backend service ecosystem. The fundamentals matter most: engineers who can write their own tests, review their own designs, and catch their own defects, and who use AI to extend that practice further and faster. Growing into the person the whole group comes to for technical judgement is part of the role.
Our ambition: engineering that runs itself
The long-term goal is a pipeline where AI agents handle the bulk of coding support, testing, and triage end-to-end, largely unattended, with engineers stepping in for genuine judgement calls and exceptions. We’re early on that path today, and we want someone in this role who treats the destination as real and pushes their team toward it deliberately.
What you’ll do
• Build and maintain internal tooling that embeds AI into day-to-day engineering work: coding assistants, AI-assisted test generation, deployments, and defect triage.
• Contribute to observability in the AI-assisted pipeline, so every stage shows what the tooling is doing, catching, and missing.
• Identify manual steps in coding, testing, and release that can run largely unattended, and help build the automation to get there.
• Split work into small, releasable pieces that ship continuously.
• Work closely with a product person on your product domain, so what you build is grounded in real delivery.
• Treat improving ways of working and driving AI adoption as a fundamental, ongoing part of delivering value.
• Work with the test and PM function to bring AI into the testing pipeline: exploratory test generation, defect clustering, flaky-test detection, and smarter prioritisation of what to test.
• Evaluate and help roll out LLM-based developer tools, for example Claude Code and similar, integrating them safely with our Jira, Confluence, and GitLab environments.
• Follow and help refine standards for responsible AI use in the SDLC: data handling, prompt hygiene, and guardrails around production and customer data.
• Mentor less experienced engineers on effective use of AI tooling.
• Work with security and compliance to make sure AI tooling meets IG’s regulatory and data-handling requirements.
• Track the metrics that show whether AI tooling is helping: cycle time, defect escape rate, test coverage, delivery turnaround. Iterate based on what the data shows.
What you’ll need for this role
• Extensive background as a Software Engineer, with demonstrated technical judgement on production systems.
• Solid, hands-on expertise in Java or a comparable backend service ecosystem.
• Strong fluency in test-driven development and pair programming as working disciplines.
• Real ownership experience: you’ve designed features or systems, built them, deployed them, and supported them in production.
• A genuine appetite for aggressive automation. You get energised by removing manual steps entirely.
• Some experience evaluating or using LLM-based developer tools in a real engineering environment.
Preferred
• Experience with MCP, agentic tooling, or Spec Driven Development.
• Familiarity with the Atlassian ecosystem (Jira, Confluence) and its APIs.
• Prior experience in financial services, trading platforms, or another regulated, high-reliability environment.
The Perks
It really is more than a job. We think like a start-up, but we deliver like a FTSE 100 — so the bar is high, and we won't pretend otherwise. We work hybrid, which means three days in the office. We’ll recognise your talent and make sure that you can still have a life – at work, and outside of it. Networks, committees, awards, sports and social clubs, mentorships, volunteering opportunities, extra time off… the list goes on.

We’re BDO. An accountancy and business advisory firm, providing the advice and solutions businesses need to navigate today’s changing world.

We’ll broaden your horizons

You’ll be someone who can work pro-actively, managing your own tasks, but you’ll also be confident collaborating with others, communicating regularly with senior managers, Directors, and BDO’s Partners to enable us to serve our clients effectively.  You’ll be encouraged to identify and draw attention to opportunities for enhancing our delivery and providing additional services to our clients. •
An in depth, up to date, knowledge of taxation with specialist knowledge and the ability to deal with complex tax issues.
•
Experience of dealing with all matters relating to the management of a portfolio of clients.
•
Experience of managing a portfolio of clients including control of client take on and engagement, billings, and identification of opportunities to improve recoveries, together with cash collection.
•
Ability to provide Tax compliance and advisory services to a wide range of clients using resource from a shared service team or via technology tools.

An understanding of potential risks to the Firm in relation to the Firm’s quality control procedures
•
Experience of leading complex projects.

Educated to degree level and/or CTA and/or ACA qualified or equivalent

We’re in it together
Mutual support and respect is one of BDO’s core values and we’re proud of our distinctive, people-centred culture.  From informal success conversations to formal mentoring and coaching, we’ll support you at every stage in your career, whatever your personal and professional needs.
We can provide the best support for our clients and people when we’re working side by side.  Our agile working framework helps us stay connected, bringing teams together where and when it counts so they can share ideas and help one another.  At BDO, you’ll always have access to the people and resources you need to do your best work.
We know that collaboration is the key to creating value for our clients and satisfying experiences at work, so we’ve invested in state-of-the-art collaboration spaces in our offices.  BDO’s people represent a wealth of knowledge and expertise, and we’ll encourage you to build your network, work alongside others, and share your skills and experiences.  With a range of multidisciplinary events and dedicated resources, you’ll never stop learning at BDO.
We’re looking forward to the future
At BDO, we help entrepreneurial businesses to succeed, fuelling the UK economy. Our success is powered by our people, which is why we’re always finding new ways to invest in you. Across the UK thousands of unique minds continue to come together to help companies we work with to achieve their ambitions
We’ve got a clear purpose, and we’re confident in our future, because we’re adapting and evolving to build on our strengths, ensuring we continue to find the right combination of global reach, integrity and expertise. We shape the future together with openness and clarity, because we believe in empowering people to think creatively about how we can do things better

The Materials Scientist will play a critical role in ensuring the operational efficiency, stability, and material consistency of polycrystalline wool manufacturing operations. The role is focused on understanding, controlling, and optimising materials from incoming raw chemicals through formulation, processing, and successful passage through the manufacturing line.
A key aspect of the role is developing strong technical relationships with raw material suppliers to gain deep insight into material chemistry, variability, and control strategies, with the objective of improving process robustness, product quality, and yield.
Nature and Scope
This position reports to the Senior Plant Manager.  Works frequently and closely with all of the Plant Management team to meet the needs of the organization in terms of product technical quality and stability.  The position will be based mainly at the Widnes manufacturing site, UK with regular remote support and travel when required to the sister plant in Buffalo, USA when required comprising approximately 10% of the role.

• Strong grounding in inorganic materials, ceramics, fibres, or high-temperature materials.
• Experience working in a manufacturing or industrial materials environment.
• Proven hands-on experience supporting production, troubleshooting processes, and improving operational stability.
• Experience working with chemical raw materials, formulations, and process recipes.
• Prior exposure to supplier technical management or external technical collaboration is highly desirable.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities with a practical, manufacturing-focused mindset.
• Ability to link material chemistry and properties to process behaviour and product performance.
• Excellent communication skills, capable of working effectively with operators, engineers, suppliers, and management.
• Comfortable working on the factory floor as well as in laboratory and office environments.
• Organised, methodical, and data driven approach to process control and improvement.
Travel & Working Pattern

People:

• Uses feedback constructively and demonstrates strong learning agility in a rapidly evolving technical environment.
Client:
• Works with business professionals and customers to understand problems, workflows, and opportunities for improvement.
• Helps determine where generative AI or agentic approaches can create meaningful value, rather than applying AI where traditional software would be more appropriate.

Builds full-stack applications that may incorporate large language models, agent-based workflows, retrieval, APIs, and other AI capabilities as part of the overall architecture.
• Supports the deployment and adoption of solutions used by real users in business and client environments.
• Considers the complete enterprise workflow when designing solutions, including users, data, integrations, business rules, human oversight, and failure scenarios.
Value:

• Applies AI where it materially improves a process, user experience, decision, or business outcome.
• Thinks critically about when an agentic solution is appropriate and when deterministic software is the better choice.
• Contributes to solutions that address real-world problems and generate measurable value for clients and the business.

The Construction Manager will be accountable for the day-to-day construction delivery and operational performance of projects across the UK&I portfolio, acting as the Principal Contractor’s operational representative on assigned sites and will ensure full compliance with Construction Phase Plans, CDM 2015, RAMS, Permit-to-Work systems, and airport operational requirements while driving right-first-time installation, construction excellence, and continuous improvement through lessons learned and performance data from ProTrack, Velocity, and Omnitracker.

• Coordinate simultaneous operations (SIMOPS) and complex work interfaces.
• Manage operational resource deployment and workforce utilisation.
• Lead construction readiness reviews covering design maturity, permits, materials, logistics, labour and stakeholder approvals.
• Support mobilisation, execution, commissioning and handover activities.
• Chair weekly construction coordination meetings and escalation forums.
• Ensure consistent use of ProTrack, Velocity and Omnitracker.
• Support monthly programme reviews, project boards and KPI reporting.
• Monitor contractor and subcontractor performance and drive corrective actions.
• Lead operational readiness reviews before major construction activities.
• Ensure compliance with Heathrow and airport governance requirements.

• 5–10 years experience leading construction or installation teams on large and complex brownfield projects.
• Experience operating within live airport environments and possession-based delivery models.
• Strong understanding of project lifecycle from pre-construction through handover.
• Knowledge of CDM 2015 Regulations and Principal Contractor obligations.
• Experience managing multi-disciplinary teams and airport stakeholders.
• Experience implementing continuous improvement and standardisation initiatives.
• Contract and project management awareness.

• NVQ Level 6/7 Construction Management or equivalent
• CSCS Black Management Card
• Higher Level Technical Qualification
• Project Management qualification desirable

Head of Global Labelling
The Role
CSL Seqirus' influenza vaccine portfolio reaches millions of people every year, and every one of those products depends on labelling that's scientifically sound, regulatory compliant, and is clear and informative for the end-user. This role leads the function responsible for labelling globally — with a seat on the regulatory leadership team and as Chair of the Global Labelling Committee.
As Head of Global Labelling, you'll shape the strategic direction of labelling for Seqirus’ worldwide portfolio, reporting to the VP Regulatory Affairs & Pharmacovigilance. It's the point where clinical data, regulatory requirement, and commercial reality converge to ultimately define how a product is understood and used.
What You'll Be Responsible For
You'll lead a global team of established labelling professionals, coaching them in strategic thinking and the leadership behaviours Seqirus expects of its people  — while owning the end-to-end labelling review and approval process and driving its continuous improvement.
You'll set global labelling strategy, balancing business need against the core obligation of getting benefit/risk information right for the people relying on it, and you'll ensure the underlying processes deliver accurate, timely labelling information that supports the safe and effective use of Seqirus’ products, importantly, including the regulatory requirements around timely safety-related updates.
Separately, you'll ensure efficient labelling operations support for the time-critical annual strain updates that seasonal influenza vaccines require.
Beyond the team, you'll provide labelling perspective to governance bodies, represent Seqirus' position in external regulatory forums, and provide labelling subject matter expertise for internal and external labelling-related audits. You'll work closely with cross-functional stakeholders including Global Safety, Clinical Development, Commercial and Supply Chain to ensure effective and timely labelling deliverables meet business needs across every region Seqirus operates in.
Experience Required
• Significant experience in Global Regulatory Affairs, with a strong focus on product labelling and management of core labelling documentation.
• Proven leadership of global, multi-country teams, including coaching and developing talent.
• Track record owning and continuously improving a regulated process end-to-end.
• Experience representing a company's positions to governance bodies or external regulators.
• Working familiarity with labelling-related audits and the regulatory frameworks that govern labelling compliance.
• Director-level experience (or equivalent) in a global pharma or biotech organization.
About CSL Seqirus
CSL Seqirus is part of CSL. As one of the largest influenza vaccine providers in the world, CSL Seqirus is a major contributor to the prevention of influenza globally and a transcontinental partner in pandemic preparedness. With state-of-the-art production facilities in the U.S., the U.K. and Australia, CSL Seqirus utilizes egg, cell and adjuvant technologies to offer a broad portfolio of differentiated influenza vaccines in more than 20 countries around the world.
To learn more about CSL, CSL Behring, CSL Seqirus and CSL Vifor visit https://www.csl.com/ and CSL Plasma at https://www.cslplasma.com/.
Our Benefits
For more information on CSL benefits visit How CSL Supports Your Well-being | CSL.
You Belong at CSL
At CSL, Inclusion and Belonging is at the core of our mission and who we are. It fuels our innovation day in and day out. By celebrating our differences and creating a culture of curiosity and empathy, we are able to better understand and connect with our patients and donors, foster strong relationships with our stakeholders, and sustain a diverse workforce that will move our company and industry into the future.

We are looking for a Principal Advisor, Risk Intelligence and Analytics to help our Enterprise Risk team turn complex data into insight that informs decisions. Product Governance Apprenticeship
Help Review and Shape Insurance Products that Work for Our Customers
Ready to earn, learn and launch your career? This is more than your first job. You’ll gain real experience, work towards a recognised qualification and build skills that will shape your future.
Insurance products can have a big impact on people's lives. Our Product Governance team reviews products throughout their life cycle, from launch to future changes or withdrawal, to check they meet customers' needs and continue to provide fair value.
This is a strategic role where you'll look at the bigger picture, use evidence to understand how products are performing and help suggest how they should be improved. You'll use data such as claims, customer feedback and complaints to spot risks and identify where products could be improved. You'll also learn how Howden meets Financial Conduct Authority (FCA) requirements and delivers good outcomes for customers.
You’ll join Howden on a permanent role and complete an 18-month development programme designed to develop your technical knowledge, professional skills and confidence to kick start your career.
What you’ll be doing?
You will begin with a structured induction before joining our Product Governance team, where you will work alongside experienced colleagues and gradually take on more responsibility.
During the programme, you'll:
• Build your knowledge of insurance products and the regulations Howden must follow.
• Learn how insurance products move through their life cycle, from initial design and launch to review, improvement or withdrawal.
• Support regular reviews to check that products meet the needs of their intended customers and continue to offer fair value.
• Review information including claims data, customer survey results, satisfaction measures and complaints.
• Help compare product performance and customer outcomes against relevant regulatory expectations.
• Collaborate and gain exposure to colleagues across broking, claims, insurers, risk, compliance and other areas of the business.
Who are we looking for?
No insurance experience is needed; we’ll teach you everything you need to know!
You'll be:
• Curious, willing to ask questions and keen to understand how insurance products work and affect customers.
• Comfortable working with numbers, data and spreadsheets. You do not need advanced Excel skills, as you will be trained in this area.
• Analytical and logical, with an interest in analysing various sources of information and spotting patterns.
• Confident building relationships and working with people from different teams.
• Organised and able to manage several responsibilities while following clear processes.
• Adaptable and able to change focus when priorities shift.
• Resilient and comfortable working in a fast-moving environment.
To be eligible for our apprenticeship, you must:
• Have the full and unrestricted right to work in the UK.
• Have lived permanently in the UK for the last 3 years.
• Have achieved a grade C/4 in GCSE English and Maths.
• Not already hold a qualification that significantly overlaps with the content of this apprenticeship.

Our application process is designed to help you show your potential, not to test what you already know!
• Online application form – no CV required: We believe you're more than just a document, so we won’t ask you to submit a CV. Please upload a blank document on the application form.
• Online gamified assessment: We’ve created games that will help us understand your natural strengths and how you approach different situations. There are no right or wrong answers. You can complete this stage on your phone or laptop, whichever suits you best!
• Pre-recorded video interview: You will record your answers to a few questions using your phone or laptop, giving you the chance to tell us more about yourself in your own time in a relaxed setting.
• Assessment centre: Our final stage is an in-person assessment centre at one of our offices. You'll take part in some fun group activities and meet our team in a relaxed setting. This day is all about getting to know you better and for you to see what it's like to be part of Howden and experience our culture. We'll cover all your travel costs for this day, because where you are now, shouldn’t hold back your future!

At Howden, people are at the heart of everything we do. As an employee-owned business, we believe success is built through collaboration, learning and supporting one another. You'll gain exposure to an exciting global industry, receive structured development throughout the summer and build relationships that could shape your future career.
You'll also benefit from:
• £23,000 and a generous pension scheme.
• Completing fully funded professional qualifications relevant for your role.
• Structured learning and development through our 18-month apprenticeship development programme.
• 25 days' annual leave, plus bank holidays.

You can also follow our TikTok accounts, @earlycareersjo and @millieinsurancecareers, for behind-the-scenes insights into life at Howden, career advice, and application tips from our Early Careers team.

At Bristol Myers Squibb, our employees often ask, “Who are you working for?”—a question that fuels collaboration, accountability, and urgency in our work. We offer uniquely interesting and meaningful work, opportunities for growth, and a supportive environment that values inclusion, wellbeing, flexibility, and comprehensive benefits. This is work that transforms the lives of patients, and the careers of those who do it.
Shape the Future of Drug Development
Are you a data science leader with the vision to transform complex, multi-modal data into life-changing scientific decisions? Bristol Myers Squibb is looking for an Associate Director of Data Science to join our cutting-edge Drug Development Data Science & Advanced Analytics (DSAA) team.
This is a rare opportunity to operate at the intersection of advanced analytics, AI/ML innovation, and clinical science — driving both strategic direction and hands-on execution across early-to-late phase drug development programs. As a senior scientific and technical leader, you will define analytical frameworks, champion methodological standards, and serve as a key partner to cross-functional stakeholders across the organization.
What You'll Do
Data Science Strategy & Scientific Leadership
• Serve as a senior scientific resource within DSAA, providing strategic direction and methodological guidance across multiple drug development programs
• Lead the design and execution of exploratory and confirmatory analyses across diverse and complex data types — from early discovery through late-phase clinical development
• Shape analytical strategy for drug development programs, contributing to decisions around trial design, endpoint selection, biomarker strategy, and evidence generation
• Represent DSAA in cross-functional program team meetings, providing authoritative scientific input and influencing development decisions through rigorous, data-driven analysis
Advanced Analytics & Modelling
• Lead the development and application of novel computational methods for patient segmentation, biomarker discovery, and precision medicine from multimodal clinical and omics datasets
• Drive the integration, mining, and visualization of diverse, high-dimensional datasets across therapeutic areas and development phases — including genomics, proteomics, imaging, and flow cytometry
• Apply and advance the use of AI/ML, deep learning, NLP, causal ML, and explainable AI across multiple data modalities and clinical development contexts
• Lead application of rigorous statistical approaches to clinical trial data, including survival analysis, longitudinal/mixed-effects modelling, causal inference, and principled handling of missing data
Data Engineering & Reproducibility
• Define and champion standards for scalable, reproducible, and well-documented analytical pipelines and codebases using Python, R, SQL, and cloud platforms
• Establish and enforce data quality frameworks to ensure fitness-for-purpose of diverse data sources across programs
• Drive adoption of scalable, automated analytical processes and best-in-class software engineering practices across the team
Leadership, Mentorship & Cross-Functional Influence
• Manage and develop a small team of data scientists, building capabilities and fostering scientific rigor and innovation
• Mentor junior and mid-level data scientists, elevating team-wide methodological and engineering standards through code reviews, collaborative problem-solving, and knowledge sharing
• Partner with lead and protocol statisticians in shaping statistical analysis plans (SAPs) for exploratory data science analyses
• Communicate complex analytical strategies and results with clarity and scientific authority to both technical and non-technical audiences, including senior leadership

Required Qualifications:
• PhD in a relevant quantitative field (e.g., Computational Biology, Biostatistics, Statistics, Biomedical Engineering, or Computer Science) with 6+ years of academic/industry experience; or a Master's Degree in a relevant quantitative field with 8+ years of industry experience
• Demonstrated mastery in data science and statistical analysis using clinical trial or electronic health records data, with a strong track record of delivering impactful results in a pharma R&D context
• Significant experience leading the development and application of statistical and machine learning models on high-dimensional data for time-to-event, longitudinal, and multivariate outcomes
• Proven expertise in AI/ML and proficiency in Python, R, SQL, and cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, Azure, Databricks)
• Deep familiarity with clinical trial design, drug development processes, and the role of biomarkers and data science in regulatory and clinical decision-making
• Demonstrated ability to define and drive analytical strategy across multiple concurrent programs, balancing scientific rigor with practical delivery
• Excellent communication, data presentation, and visualization skills with the ability to convey complex concepts to diverse audiences
Preferred Qualifications:
• Experience with genomics, proteomics, imaging, flow cytometry, or immunobiology datasets from clinical trials
• Experience with NLP, causal ML, explainable AI, and survival analysis/time-to-event modelling
• Knowledge of molecular biology and understanding of disease pathways
• Experience with real-world data (RWD/RWE) sources, including EHR, claims, or registry data
• Familiarity with novel clinical trial designs (e.g., adaptive, platform, or biomarker-enriched trials)
• Prior experience in a people management or formal scientific leadership role
• Experience with cloud-based scalable compute and deployment patterns for large-scale data processing and model training

Our Team
Fancy a career at the sharp end of how the world actually connects? Join an ambitious and collaborative engineering team at the cutting edge of global data communications.

Job Summary
Ready to turn your degree into a career that actually matters?
As a Graduate High-Speed Validation Engineer, you'll be trained up to test and validate next-generation semiconductor devices that are shaping the future of global connectivity — the chips inside the networks that move the world's data.
No two days will look the same: one week you might be in new product design meetings helping shape how a device gets tested, the next you'll be in the lab taking real measurements on components running at 10Gbit/s and beyond.
You'll learn from experienced engineers who genuinely want to see you grow, get hands-on with industry-leading test equipment, and pick up skills — from Python/LabVIEW automation to high-speed signal integrity — that will set you up for a serious engineering career.
This is your launchpad. Bring the curiosity and work ethic; we'll bring the mentorship, the kit, and the opportunity.

• Support new product design meetings and help develop test approaches for evaluating new products
• Assist in building validation solutions for new products — covering software, hardware, and documentation
• Help identify the right bench-top test equipment for validating new products
• Learn to build test automation software using Python or LabVIEW
• Work closely with designers, product, test, and applications engineers as part of a genuinely collaborative team
• Take part in validation review meetings and contribute your findings
• Help create clear, accurate validation reports
• Get hands-on testing high-speed optical components, ICs, and modules
• Take high-speed lab measurements on products operating at data rates of 10Gbit/s and above
• Build your knowledge of high-speed signal integrity, including exposure to schematic entry/layout using Altium PCB tools
Minimum Qualifications
• BSc/MSc in Electrical/Electronic Engineering (EE/ECE) or a closely related discipline
• 0–2 years' relevant experience — this role is designed for recent graduates ready to build their career in high-speed validation
• A genuine curiosity for electronics, test, and measurement, and a willingness to learn fast
• Able to stay focused and positive in a fast-paced, dynamic R&D environment
• A natural team player who enjoys sharing knowledge and asking questions
• Good interpersonal and communication skills
• Strong self-motivation — comfortable picking up new tools and techniques independently
• An analytical mindset, attention to detail, and a creative approach to problem-solving
Career Growth Philosophy
At Semtech, we believe that innovation starts with people — and that includes the people just starting out.
That's why we're committed to empowering your professional development through mentorship, structured learning, and a collaborative, idea-rich environment from day one.
Our pay-for-performance culture rewards initiative and celebrates meaningful contributions, no matter how early in your career you are.
Join us, and be part of a team that's building the future of connectivity — together.

Your Role:
As a Process Safety Manager, you will provide technical leadership, consultation and direction on Process Safety Management (PSM) across the Speke site.
You will support both new product introduction projects and ongoing manufacturing operations, ensuring that process safety systems remain compliant with regulatory requirements and industry standards. Acting as a key technical expert for the site, you will work closely with internal stakeholders, senior leadership and external regulatory authorities to strengthen process safety capability and continuously improve PSM performance.
Your Responsibilities:
• Lead and support site compliance with COMAH Regulations and Process Safety Management requirements.
• Support compliance with relevant regulations and standards, including DSEAR, ATEX and Pressure Safety Regulations.
• Act as a key point of contact with external competent authorities, including the Health & Safety Executive (HSE), supporting regulatory communication, incident notification and management of relevant site changes.
• Coordinate implementation and continuous improvement of the site's PSM system and provide regular updates to senior management.
• Develop the site's Process Safety business plan and improvement roadmap and provide leadership for its implementation.
• Lead and chair Process Safety activities including Process Hazard Reviews (PHRs), facility siting assessments, incident investigations and project/change assessments.
• Review and approve key Process Safety documentation, including the COMAH Safety Report, PHRs, risk assessments, change controls and HSE event investigations.
• Identify and escalate Process Safety compliance gaps and develop practical solutions to address them.
• Provide technical expertise and mentorship on significant Process Safety investigations, changes and improvement initiatives.
• Develop Process Safety capability across the organisation through education, coaching, consultation and technical direction.
• Influence internal stakeholders and collaborate with external agencies while identifying and sharing external best practices.
• Support site self-assessments, management reviews, regulatory inspections and customer audits.
• Conduct Process Safety audits at other manufacturing sites and bring relevant best practices back to Speke.
• Support the site's Emergency Response Team and Management Control Group.
• Participate in the HSE Leadership Team for Process Safety-related topics.
What You Need to Succeed (minimum qualifications)
• Degree in Chemical Engineering or another relevant engineering discipline.
• Strong technical knowledge and practical experience in Process Safety Management within a manufacturing or process environment.
• Good understanding of Process Safety regulatory requirements and risk-management methodologies.
• Experience conducting or leading Process Hazard Reviews, risk assessments and/or Process Safety investigations.
• Ability to provide technical direction and influence stakeholders across different functions and levels of an organisation.
• Strong communication, problem-solving and stakeholder-management skills.
What will give you a competitive edge (preferred qualifications)
• IChemE Professional Process Safety Engineer registration/accreditation.
• Strong working knowledge of COMAH, DSEAR, ATEX and pressure systems regulations.
• Experience working directly with the HSE or other competent regulatory authorities.
• Experience leading PHRs and supporting COMAH Safety Reports.
• Experience within pharmaceutical, chemical or another highly regulated process-manufacturing environment.
• Experience auditing Process Safety Management systems across manufacturing facilities.
• Experience developing and implementing Process Safety improvement strategies or roadmaps.
Additional Information
• Location: Speke, Liverpool, UK

Discover a new kind of career in healthcare as a Functional Specialist.
We have clinic locations across Wales and offer a hybrid working environment.
Working in healthcare, and looking for a change? If you’re a nurse (RMN, RNLD, RGN), occupational therapist, physiotherapist or paramedic, you could use your skills in a different way as a functional specialist.
At Capita Health Assessment Advisory Service (HAAS) we provide unbiased, comprehensive assessments for claimants of Government benefits.
Job title:
Functional Specialist - Wales (Welsh Speaking).
Job Description:
Our functional specialists write reports which help the Department for Work and Pensions (DWP) make important decisions about a person’s health and care.
Maybe you’re a nurse right now and you’d like to move away from direct care - this role offers you the chance to not only improve your assessment skills, but also to use your knowledge and experience to make important clinical recommendations.
Or you might be an occupational therapist, physiotherapist or paramedic wanting to learn how to evaluate situations in a different way in a different setting. We’re looking for people with the compassion and experience to understand our claimants’ health conditions/disabilities and how they impact their lives.
This role is different from other healthcare professions, and that’s why we take your training and development seriously. You’ll receive comprehensive training with time set aside for self-development learning.
If you’re looking for a change, including more regular working hours, a competitive salary and are ready to expand your skills and experience, this could be the role for you.
What you’ll do in this role:
•
Conduct functional assessments which include initial reviews, face-to-face, video or telephone assessments to evaluate how a claimant’s health condition or disability affects them for various types of benefit.
•
Analyse and interpret clinical information and supporting evidence.
•
Write detailed evidence-based reports to support the DWP/DfC in making informed and objective decisions - no treatment or diagnosis required.
•
Use IT systems to support clinical decision-making and report writing.
•
Develop your clinical knowledge and constantly learn about health conditions which are less familiar to you.
What are PIP and WCA?
•
Personal Independence Payment (PIP) is a benefit for people with a long-term health condition or impairment. It is paid to make a contribution to the extra costs that disabled people may face, to help them lead full, active and independent lives.
•
Work Capability Assessment (WCA) is a functional assessment that looks at a range of different activities relating to physical, mental, intellectual and cognitive functions, to help DWP determine a customer's capability for work or work-related activity.

Working at Bank of America Chester offers a far-reaching global career for a world-renowned organisation, whilst being ideally situated against the backdrop of the rolling North Wales hills and the banks of the serene River Dee.
Role Description:
We are seeking an experienced and motivated Security Detection & Response Analyst (SDR II) to join the GIS Monitoring and Triage team. This role supports cybersecurity operations across threat detection, investigation, response, and continuous service improvement.
You should be an experienced security practitioner capable of operating within the end-to-end detection and response lifecycle (detect → investigate → respond → improve), combining broad analytical capability with an engineering mindset to rapidly identify, investigate, and contain threats. The analyst will operate across multiple security domains, validating detections, investigating threats, and executing response actions with sound judgment.
This role requires cross-domain security expertise, broad analytical and engineering capabilities, and the ability to leverage automation, orchestration, and AI-driven technologies to improve detection outcomes, reduce manual effort, and continuously enhance overall security effectiveness.
Working Pattern:
This is a full-time role (40 hours per week), with standard working hours of 7:00AM to 6:00PM 4 days per week (Sunday to Wednesday or Wednesday to Saturday) to align with the nature of the support provided by the team. Flexibility may occasionally be required to support business, operational, or project deliverables.
Responsibilities:
• You will operate within the end-to-end detection and response lifecycle (detect → investigate → respond → improve), including analysing logs and telemetry from multiple sources to establish attack scope, impact, and root cause
• You will build, validate, tune, and optimize detection logic and coverage, leveraging attacker tactics, techniques, and procedures (TTPs) and frameworks such as MITRE ATT&CK to improve accuracy and reduce false positives
• Execute and coordinate security event response activities, including containment, isolation, escalation, and remediation, applying sound judgment during active engagements
• You will maintain and improve automation and orchestration capabilities, including SOAR workflows, automated playbooks, scripted response actions, and AI-driven enhancements to reduce manual effort and improve detection and response outcomes. Accountable for measurable improvements in MTTR, detection quality, and signal-to-noise ratio
• You will document and communicate security event findings, including timelines and lessons learned, while providing clear updates to stakeholders and driving continuous improvement in detection and response processes
• Identify gaps in monitoring and detection coverage, contributing to operational maturity through continuous improvement initiatives, metrics, and enhancements to detection, response, and automation capabilities
• Support integration of partner use cases into detection and monitoring workflows
• Guide and instruct junior members of the team to support the achievement of professional goals
What we are looking for:
• Experience in security operations, incident response, detection engineering, or related cybersecurity functions within a production environment
• Experience in security detection, investigation, and response across multiple domains, with the ability to pivot across data sources and independently manage end-to-end investigations from initial triage through post-incident improvement
• Ability to build, validate, and tune detections and response workflows, including reducing false positives.
• Considerable proficiency in log analysis, telemetry interpretation, and cross-system data correlation, including the ability to query, manipulate, and optimize data using KQL, SPL, SQL, or similar languages for investigative and detection use cases
• Practical experience with containment, response actions, and automation, including developing or maintaining SOAR workflows, API integrations, and scripted response actions using sound judgment
• Experience with security platforms and technologies, including SIEM, EDR/XDR, identity security, and cloud security
• Working knowledge of identity and access systems and common attack paths, including credential theft, privilege escalation, and session/token abuse
• Considerable understanding of attacker tactics, techniques, and procedures (TTPs), including MITRE ATT&CK
• Record of improving operational effectiveness, including reducing alert noise, improving detection coverage, and decreasing mean time to detect and respond
• Great analytical, decision-making, and communication skills, including the ability to clearly articulate findings, provide timely incident updates to both technical and non-technical stakeholders, and operate effectively in high-pressure scenarios
• Ability to operate with minimal supervision and make risk-informed decisions quickly
Skills that will help:
• Exceptional communication and executive presence, with the ability to influence at all organizational levels
• Process discipline
• Leadership competency in geographically diverse matrixed environment.
• Relevant Cyber Security Certificate
• Worked in SOC environment before
• Familiarity with Cyber Security and Information Technology.
• Strong problem-solving and critical thinking skills.
• Effective communication and interpersonal skills.
Benefits of working at Bank of America: UK

• Carrying out 3D modelling & 2D design/ draught work whilst maintaining/ updating and modifying existing designs/ diagrams.

• Administer of Windchill/PDMLink, drawing identification database and Drawing Office documentation.

Personal Qualities

• Ability to communicate clearly and in a professional manner with colleagues, team members, other departments, managers & outside organisations.

Qualifications

• Degree in Mechanical Design or related Engineering discipline.
Experience

• At least 3 years’ experience in designing with PTC Creo 2.0 or above.
• Experience of using AutoCAD 2015 or above.
• At least 2 years’ experience in administering and releasing using Windchill PDMLink 10.1.

• Experience of bespoke low volume mechanical design projects.

• Proven hands-on practical skills and good understanding/sense of aesthetics, ergonomics, shock and vibration effects
• Familiar with a comprehensive range of materials and manufacturing systems.

• Analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to evaluate reports.

Ares’ Alternative Credit strategy focuses on investing in businesses and assets that generate contractual cash flows and fills gaps in the capital markets between credit, private equity and real assets.

SiFive is looking for a principal-level hardware engineer who is passionate about designing industry-leading CPU and interconnect IP to help drive the tidal wave of adoption of RISC-V as the architecture of choice for SOC designs across a broad variety of vertical applications. We’re creating massively customizable IP and improving time-to-market by designing hardware as highly-configurable generators. We leverage technology and ideas from the software industry to execute hardware design with the agility of software development.

Designing the best interconnect IP in the world, based on the revolutionary open RISC-V and TileLink architectures

Mastering the art of designing hardware as configurable generators in a domain-specific software language for elaborating circuits

Implement RTL generators such that elements self-configure to optimally connect to each other

Enhance future designs to provide higher performance, more efficient multi-core and multi-system coherence
•
Design extensive configurability in as a first-class consideration

Integrate new design content into SiFive’s Chisel/FIRRTL framework and contribute to improvements to that framework to enable automatic configuration/generation of documentation, verification testbenches and tests, and packaged software.

•
Ensure that knowledge is shared via creation and maintenance of great documentation and participation in a culture of collaborative design

Knowledge of cache and cache coherency architectures and concepts
•
Experience with NoC or other interconnect fabrics
•
Familiarity with industry-standard bus protocols (AXI, AHB, APB, CHI, CXL, UCIe)
•
Ability to architect solutions to connect bus fabrics of disparate protocols
•
Strong software engineering skills/background, including:

Object-oriented, aspect-oriented, and particularly functional programming
•
Templated metaprogramming, in any language
•
Compiler infrastructures, particularly for domain-specific languages
•
Data modeling, particularly intermediate representations for optimizing or transforming compiler passes
•
Test-driven development, particularly ability to write adaptive unit tests
•
Proficiency with hardware (RTL) design in Verilog, System Verilog, or VHDL
•
Attention to detail and a focus on high-quality design
•
Ability to work well with others and a belief that engineering is a team sport
•
BS/MS in EE, CE, CS or a related technical discipline, or equivalent experience
Nice to have
•
Experience with Scala/Chisel, Bluespec, or some other language/DSL for expressing configurable hardware via software

Knowledge of RISC-V architecture
•
Experience with Git/Github, Jira, Confluence

The Safety Engineer is a recognised subject matter expert within the safety and reliability discipline, bringing both technical depth and practical application of established safety standards and methodologies. The role involves leading and supporting activities such as hazard identification, safety assessments, and failure analysis, ensuring that risks are systematically identified, evaluated, and effectively managed throughout the product lifecycle.
Working closely with multidisciplinary engineering teams, the Safety Engineer plays a critical role in shaping and influencing product design and development. By integrating safety considerations from the earliest stages, they help ensure that solutions are not only compliant with relevant standards but are also robust, reliable, and fit for purpose in demanding operational environments.
Within Cyber UK programmes, the role carries particular responsibility for delivering high-quality safety and reliability analyses, including FMEA and FMECA. The Safety Engineer ensures that these analyses are thorough, traceable, and aligned with project and regulatory requirements, ultimately contributing to the development of secure, dependable systems that can be trusted in mission-critical applications.
Key Responsibilities
• Conduct requirements and design assessments to systematically identify, evaluate, and mitigate hazards throughout the product development lifecycle.

• Produce high-quality safety and reliability documentation, including planning and compliance documents, in accordance with company standards and project requirements.
• Provide accurate work estimates, identify cost-effective solutions, and deliver work predictably to support overall team performance.
• Operate effectively with minimal supervision, demonstrating autonomy and sound technical judgement.
• Generate technical inputs for product-level design reviews and approve significant technical documentation.
• Act as a subject matter expert, providing specialist guidance and support to wider engineering teams and, where appropriate, external stakeholders.
• Mentor and support the development of less experienced engineers, fostering knowledge sharing and continuous improvement.
• Identify and champion process improvements to enhance engineering efficiency and innovation.
• Apply relevant defence and industry standards, including Def Stan 00-056, MIL-STD 1629, MIL-HDB 217F, ARP4761, and ARP4754 (for airborne systems).
• Maintain and manage the hazard log, ensuring hazards, mitigations, and verification activities are accurately captured, tracked, and closed through the lifecycle.
• Define and derive safety requirements, ensuring clear traceability from hazards through to implementation and verification.
• Support the development and maintenance of the safety case, including structuring arguments, evidence, and compliance with applicable standards.
• Facilitate and lead safety reviews and workshops, such as hazard identification sessions, design reviews, and risk assessments with cross-functional teams.
• Ensure safety requirements are verified and validated, working closely with test and integration teams to confirm that mitigations are effective.
• Interface with customers, regulators, and assurance bodies as required, providing technical justification and supporting audits or certification activities.
• Assess and manage the impact of design changes on system safety, ensuring that modifications do not introduce unacceptable risk.
• Support configuration and change management processes, ensuring safety artefacts remain consistent with the evolving system design.
• Promote a strong safety culture within the engineering team, encouraging proactive identification and management of risks.
• Contribute to bid and proposal activities, providing safety input to support technical solutions, cost estimation, and risk assessment.
Required Experience, Skills and Qualifications
• Highly organised, self-managing, able to manage multiple activities at any one time
• Excellent interpersonal skills, able to engage effectively with all audiences/stakeholders at all levels in the organisation
• Working knowledge of relevant safety standards and regulatory frameworks, such as Def Stan 00-56, MIL-STD 1629, MIL-HDBK-217F, ARP4761, and ARP4754, and the ability to apply them pragmatically.
• Experience in hazard analysis techniques, such as PHA, FHA, FTA (Fault Tree Analysis), and Event Tree Analysis (ETA).
• Experience in developing and maintaining safety cases, including structuring arguments and linking evidence to safety requirements.
• Strong understanding of risk management principles, including risk assessment, mitigation, and acceptance processes.
• Ability to influence and challenge engineering decisions constructively, particularly in safety-critical contexts.
• Experience working within regulated or safety-critical environments (e.g. defence, aerospace, rail, nuclear, or similar).
• Understanding of verification and validation (V&V) processes, particularly in relation to safety requirements
• Awareness of configuration management principles, ensuring alignment between design, documentation, and safety artefacts.

We are united by a shared passion and no-limits mindset, and our strength lies in our ability to collaborate as a powerful international team comprised of 24,000 employees spanning over 56 countries.
People join Howden for many different reasons, but they stay for the same one: our culture. It’s what sets us apart, and the reason our employees have been turning down headhunters for years. Whatever your priorities – work / life balance, career progression, sustainability, volunteering – you’ll find like-minded people driving change at Howden.
The Role
At Howden, we're on an exciting journey to accelerate growth across our largest and most strategically important clients globally. At the centre of this sits the Multinational Clients Practice (MCP), a globally connected team that helps multinational organisations navigate complex risk challenges and access the full breadth of Howden's expertise and network.
MCP plays a critical role in connecting clients to specialist capabilities, coordinating global relationships and creating growth opportunities across products, geographies and industries. To support its next phase of growth, MCP is executing an ambitious strategy focused on client engagement, cross-practice collaboration, operational excellence and sustainable revenue growth.
As Growth Execution Manager (GEM) for MCP, you will help turn strategy into action. Working across MCP's growth agenda, you will lead and support initiatives that improve commercial performance, strengthen collaboration and enhance the client experience. This will include projects spanning growth planning, business performance, cross-selling, network engagement and operating model enhancement.
Working closely with colleagues across the Howden One Network and wider business, you will help bring together expertise from different regions and practices to unlock opportunities for clients and Howden. Reporting to the Head of Growth Execution, MCP, you will be embedded within the MCP team and form part of a wider GEM community across Howden. If you are a proactive, results-oriented individual who enjoys building relationships, solving complex challenges and driving meaningful change, we'd love to hear from you.
What you'll do
Growth Execution Focus
• Partner with the Head of Growth Execution and MCP leadership to shape and deliver MCP's growth plan, aligning initiatives to strategic priorities with clear objectives and metrics.
• Drive execution of strategic initiatives across the MCP business plan, maintaining momentum and accountability to deliver measurable commercial outcomes.
• Lead and support projects spanning client development, cross-selling, Howden One Network engagement, business performance and operating model enhancement.
• Build strong relationships across MCP, Specialty, Commercial, International and the Howden One Network to identify opportunities and remove barriers to growth.
• Establish governance, tracking and reporting to monitor progress and provide actionable insights to leadership.
• Share best practice across MCP and the wider business to improve collaboration and commercial performance.
• Collaborate with the Growth Execution Manager community to align priorities and accelerate growth delivery across Howden.
Project Management and Delivery
• Lead and support the delivery of MCP growth initiatives from planning through to implementation, coordinating stakeholders across MCP and the wider business to achieve successful outcomes.
• Establish clear milestones, monitor progress and manage risks and dependencies to maintain momentum and accountability.
• Prepare updates, insights and recommendations for leadership forums, steering committees and governance meetings.
• Work closely with Finance, Marketing, Operations, Technology and Data teams to translate business requirements into practical solutions that support MCP's growth objectives.
Who we're looking for
• Experience in the insurance industry (not consulting for insurance, but direct experience of working in insurance)
• 2-3 years of consulting, strategy, or project management experience; experience managing technology or digital delivery projects is an advantage.
• Strong relationship-building skills with the ability to influence senior stakeholders across geographies.
• Entrepreneurial mindset with a proactive, solutions-oriented approach.
• A team player who thrives in a fast-paced, collaborative, and international environment.
• Experience with data analysis is an advantage.
What do we offer in return?
A career that you define. At Howden, we value diversity – there is no one Howden type. Instead, we’re looking for individuals who share the same values as us:
•
Our successes have all come from someone brave enough to try something new
•
We support each other in the small everyday moments and the bigger challenges
•
We are determined to make a positive difference at work and beyond
Reasonable adjustments
We're committed to providing reasonable accommodations at Howden to ensure that our positions align well with your needs.  Besides the usual adjustments such as software, IT, and office setups, we can also accommodate other changes such as flexible hours* or hybrid working*.
If you're excited by this role but have some doubts about whether it’s the right fit for you, send us your application – if your profile fits the role’s criteria, we will be in touch to assist in helping to get you set up with any reasonable adjustments you may require.

By joining Sedgwick, you'll be part of something truly meaningful. It’s what our 33,000 colleagues do every day for people around the world who are facing the unexpected. We invite you to grow your career with us, experience our caring culture, and enjoy work-life balance. Here, there’s no limit to what you can achieve.
Subsidence Claims Consultant
Job Location: UK wide, hybrid working
Job Type: Permanent
Remuneration: Competitive salary taking into account skills, experience and qualifications
We have a fantastic opportunity for Subsidence Claims Consultant UK wide.
We now have an exciting opportunity for a subsidence Claims Consultant within our award-winning Subsidence Services Division.
Acting as a focal point for clients and their customers, you will be responsible for managing a portfolio of domestic and commercial claims up to an agreed value. Following training and licensing, you will be empowered to make all decisions on your claims. The key requirement is to accelerate claims through to conclusion, achieved by high levels of autonomy.
You will be the first point of contact for customers and clients, supporting and resolving any queries they may have. You will progress claims towards conclusion with the authority to make all technical decisions on the claim. You will produce client-specific reports and documentation for the customer, ensuring an accurate action plan is maintained throughout the claim and all stakeholders are updated when any revisions are introduced. You will be responsible for the reserve accuracy of the claim and liaise with suppliers to ensure progress and delivery of services provided by our suppliers.
If you're looking for a combined office and remote role where you can manage claims with autonomy and flexibility, this could be perfect for you.
This is perfect for someone with experience in claims management, strong communication skills, and a proactive approach to customer service.
The skills you will have when you apply:
•
Experience in managing subsidence claims: Previous experience in a subsidence claims environment is essential.
•
Organisational Skills: Organised, diligent, and able to run tasks through to completion.
•
Communication Skills: Excellent communication and negotiation skills, with experience handling demanding customers sympathetically but firmly over the phone.
•
Adaptability: Conscientious, hard-working, and flexible during high volumes, with the ability to cope with a fast-changing working environment.
•
Professional Attitude: Enthusiastic, professional, and positive attitude, with a desire to embrace innovative working practices.
The skills that will be developed once working:
•
Comprehensive Training: You'll receive all the Sedgwick-specific training needed to excel in your role.
•
Professional Development: We are committed to helping you work towards the Chartered Institute of Loss Adjusters' Cert CILA qualification.
What we’ll give you for this role:
Remuneration & more
•
Competitive salary taking into account skills, experience and qualifications
•
A Self Invested Personal Pension Scheme (SIPP)
•
Holiday allowance of 25 days plus bank holidays
•
Flexible working from our office or your home
Health & support
•
Private healthcare plan (including pre-existing conditions)
•
Life assurance
•
Employee assistance programme for employee wellbeing
•
Group Income Protection
Other benefits
•
Voluntary flexible benefits – green car scheme, travel insurance, dental cover, cycle to work scheme, season ticket loan, wellbeing and digital GP applications
•
Discounts on various products and services
This isn't just a position, it's a pivotal role in shaping our industry
At Sedgwick, you won't just build your career; you'll cultivate a team of experts. Our Sedgwick University offering empowers you to excel as well as your team members, with the most comprehensive training program in the industry which includes more than 15,000 courses on demand, training specific to roles, and opportunities to continue formal education.
Together, we're not only reshaping the insurance landscape, we’re building a legacy of talent. Come and be a catalyst for change within our industry.

At Bristol Myers Squibb, our employees often ask, “Who are you working for?”—a question that fuels collaboration, accountability, and urgency in our work. Our purpose-driven culture inspires us to discover, develop, and deliver innovative medicines to prevail over serious diseases. We offer uniquely interesting and meaningful work, opportunities for growth, and a supportive environment that values inclusion, wellbeing, flexibility, and comprehensive benefits. This is work that transforms the lives of patients, and the careers of those who do it.
Position Summary
The Associate Director of Biostatistics is a member of cross-functional Development teams and contributes to trial design, protocol development, analysis planning, interpretation of results, and preparation of regulatory submissions. With appropriate experience, the Associate Director of Biostatistics can have responsibilities for supporting a particular indication of an asset. These individuals develop collaborative relationships and work effectively with the Biostatistics indication/asset Lead, and other cross functional team members.
This role is based in Uxbridge and requires 50% onsite presence.
Key Responsibilities
• Collaborates in design of innovative and efficient clinical trials, including the selection of study population/endpoints to address study objectives, and contributes to project development strategy
• Defends protocols and analysis plans at internal governance reviews and provides independent reviews of complex protocols.
• Independently authors and/or reviews protocol, statistical analysis plan, clinical study reports, associated publications, and other study level documents
• Presents summary data and analyses results, in a clear, concise, complete, and transparent manner
• Provides statistical support and leadership to address health authority request, publication, presentation, and other public release of information
• Manages multiple studies to ensure consistency and adherence to standards within an indication or therapeutic area
• Applies extensive knowledge of statistical / clinical trials methodology as it relates to clinical development
• Invests in developing knowledge outside of traditional statistical expertise in the clinical, regulatory and commercial environments with demonstrated application to study design.
• Effectively engages as a matrix team member on project teams, to act as a scientific and strategic partner in the drug development process
• Compliant with BMS processes and SOPs, adherence to global and project standards within an indication or therapeutic area and responsible for quality of deliverable
• Contributes to external and internal statistical community of practice
• Develops & advises team members
• Effectively communicates the DQS Mission and Vision in a fashion that generates pride, excitement and commitment within DQS.
Qualifications & Experience
• PhD (6+ years’ experience) or MSc (8+ years’ experience) in statistics or biostatistics or related scientific field with clinical trials, drug development, pharmaceutical industry or healthcare experience
• Proficiency in scientific computing/programming (SAS, R or Python) and implementation of advanced statistical analysis, data manipulation, graphing & simulation.
• Great interpersonal, communication, writing and organizational skills
• Expertise in statistical/clinical trials methodology as it related to clinical development and ability to apply to relevant clinical development framework
• Good understanding of regulatory landscape and experience with participating in regulatory interactions
• Demonstrate collaboration, organizational/ leadership abilities, and interpersonal skills
• Demonstrate ability to plan, organize, and prioritize multiple work assignments, and strong project management skills

Job Description
Location Woodchester
Salary up to £36,000 depending on experience.
As the warehouse operations at Woodchester continue to evolve, this is a particularly exciting time to join the team. With the introduction of advanced storage automation and an expanding role in supporting Renishaw’s service requirements, the department is entering a period of significant development and innovation. We are looking for a proactive and motivated individual who can help shape these changes, ensuring our processes are robust, efficient, and ready to meet the future needs of the business.
Responsibilities
• Supervise and lead a warehouse team to support the efficient receipt, storage, and distribution of goods via effective workload organisation and prioritisation.
• Demonstrate good working knowledge of Health & Safety in the warehouse environment, leading by example by promotion of best practice and identifying & implementing areas for improvement.
• Ownership of local delivery, quality, and cost measures with a focus on achieving and exceeding targets.
• Pro-actively identify, plan, and implement process improvements and projects to increase operational efficiency of the area.
• Adhere to customs/trade compliance legislation with regard to the movement of goods.
• Deputise for the Warehouse Section Manager where required and provide support to other site warehouses if needed.
Key Requirements
• Ability to lead and motivate a team in a busy operational environment focused on achieving targets and identifying/actioning areas for improvement.
• Possess good working knowledge of warehouse operations and related systems.
• Possess good knowledge of Compliance aspects that impact warehouse operations, eg: Export Controls, Dangerous Goods legislation & Plastic Packaging Tax.
• Good communication skills, written & verbal, are required as interaction with a wide range of business functions is integral to the role.
Person specification
The successful applicant will be able to work under pressure in a busy operational environment whilst maintaining a positive ‘can do’ attitude. As a Supervisor they will be able to organise and prioritise workload effectively, meeting customer expectations.
Benefits
When you join Renishaw, we're committing to your future career. That's because we believe in developing our people's skills and promoting them internally. We also offer a benefits package that's highly desirable; including a 9% non-contributory pension, discretionary annual bonus, *subsidised onsite restaurants and *coffee shops, free parking, *car sharing scheme and *24 hour fitness centres. ( not available at all sites).
We also want to promote a healthy work-life balance as much as possible, so we have introduced a hybrid working policy which allows for a combination of home and office based working depending on the nature of your role. We also offer a variable working programme, 25 days holiday plus bank holidays, Life Assurance policy of 12 times annual salary, Cycle to Work scheme, enhanced maternity pay subject to qualifying criteria, Health Cash Plan, the option to join Renishaw Health Trust (Aviva) and an Employee Assistance Programme for employees and family.
